remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom condo in the heart of Azusa! Offering a thoughtfully designed two-story layout, this inviting home combines comfort, style, and everyday convenience. Step inside to discover beautiful stone-look porcelain tile flooring throughout the dining and kitchen areas, complemented by an updated kitchen featuring modern cabinetry, quartz countertops, a sleek stainless steel sink, and newly installed French doors that bring in natural light and provide a lovely connection to the outdoor space.
